# Conflict 5: pawning the crown jewels hands the work of art to Venice; vanilla's chain moves it the same way.
oe_mf_jewels_to_venice = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:VEN exists = work_of_art:byzantine_crown_jewels }

            if = {
                limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
                move_art_and_owner = { location = c:VEN.capital country = c:VEN }
            }
        }
    }
}
